# Skill templates

This folder contains shared starter templates for creating future skills and operational guidance.

## Template pattern

If this is the skill itself, use `SKILL.md`. If it is a directory or project overview, use `README.md`.

```md
# Skill title

## Purpose

## When to use

## Scope

## Expected behavior

## Validation
```

Templates should remain generic, concise, and easy to adapt to different projects and workflows.
